title: app/<slug>/debug-tool.json - how the TMF Debug Tool reaches this app's client PCs (docs/DEBUG_TOOL.md)

delivery.description: bundle: the pinned tool zip is copied into the delivery folder and the installer offers an optional, unticked task that installs it beside the app (outside run.dist). on-demand: nothing is shipped; the engineer carries the tool when a session is needed. none: this customer does not use it.

version.description: Pinned Debug Tool release: 1.x (newest 1.*), 1.2.x (newest 1.2.*) or 1.2.3 (exact). Required for delivery=bundle.

note.description: Free text for the handover checklist (e.g. the customer's consent reference).
